_comment: Bundle 4A E2E — Drive Comments. Workflow: agent creates a doc, posts a comment, lists comments, resolves it, and lists again (with include_resolved=true) to confirm the flag flipped. Requires OAuth env (COLMENA_GOOGLE_OAUTH_*) + GEMINI_API_KEY + DATABASE_URL. Run: `set -a; source .env; set +a; cargo run --bin dag_engine -- run tests/graphs/agents/gdocs_bundle4a_e2e.json --agent-session-id g_b4a_$(date +%s) --include-extra-info`

test_payload.prompt:
Exercise the Bundle 4A Drive Comments surface (3 new tools).

1. gdocs_create({title: 'Bundle4A E2E <UTC iso>'}). Capture doc_id.
2. gdocs_append_markdown({doc_id, markdown: '# Bundle4A test\n\nA short paragraph so the comment has context.\n'}).

3. gdocs_add_comment({doc_id, content: 'TEST_COMMENT_42 — please ignore (E2E)'}). Capture comment_id. Verify the response carries created_time and resolved=false.

4. gdocs_list_comments({doc_id, include_resolved: false}). Confirm ≥1 entry with the comment_id from step3, content starting with 'TEST_COMMENT_42', and resolved=false.

5. gdocs_resolve_comment({doc_id, comment_id: <step3.comment_id>, content: 'resolved by E2E agent'}). Expect {ok: true}.

6. gdocs_list_comments({doc_id, include_resolved: false}). Confirm the comment_id is GONE (resolved=true comments are hidden under the default filter).

7. gdocs_list_comments({doc_id, include_resolved: true}). Confirm the comment_id IS present and its resolved field equals true.

Final report (<200 words): doc_id + comment_id + PASS/FAIL per step. If any step errors, paste the error verbatim.

config.system_message: You are testing the colmena Bundle 4A Drive Comments tools. Use ONLY the listed tool names. If a tool returns an error, report it verbatim and stop.
